resources.name: 3D Schrödinger-Poisson solver

access.notes: Open-source equivalent to NEXTNANO³; any solver capable of self-consistent 3D effective-mass Schrödinger-Poisson with strain and polarization may be used (e.g., nextnano++, a custom finite-difference/FEM code).

resources.notes: The agent must use an open-source 3D Schrödinger-Poisson solver. The proprietary NEXTNANO³ used in the paper is replaced by an equivalent implementation.

resources.name: Material parameters of AlxGa1-xN

access.notes: Lattice constants, elastic constants, piezoelectric constants, deformation potentials, effective masses, spontaneous polarization, dielectric constants for AlxGa1-xN as a function of x, taken from the paper's Table II and the reference Vurgaftman & Meyer, J. Appl. Phys. 94, 3675 (2003). These can be hard-coded in the solver input.

resources.notes: Publicly known material parameters; no external file download needed.

resources.name: Nanowire heterostructure geometry

access.notes: Exact geometric dimensions (GaN core: length 35 nm, diameter 30 nm; ND thickness 7 monolayers ≈ 1.7 nm; barrier thickness 28 monolayers ≈ 7 nm; cap 20 nm; lateral shell parameterization: lateral growth rate 11% of axial for AlN, linear scaling with Al content) are given in the paper's Sec. IV and can be expressed directly in the solver input.

resources.notes: Geometry dimensions are fully specified; no external geometry files are required.
